paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : Ablation studies on n-best candidates generations (Beam search and Sampling search) on valid set of WMT15 De-En.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the BLEU score achieved by different methods for n-best candidate generation during machine translation. The x-axis represents the Average Laggng (AL) in AL units, with a linear scale ranging from 2.5 to 12.5, and the tick labels are spaced at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis represents the BLEU score, with a linear scale ranging from 24 to 31, and the tick labels are spaced at intervals of 1. The first line, labeled “Inconsistency-CE,” is a solid dark blue line consisting of circular markers, starting at approximately 24.8 and reaching a peak of approximately 29.2 at an AL value of 7.5. A second line, labeled “Consistency-Bi + sampling,” is a dashed light green line with triangular markers, starting at approximately 26.3 and reaching a peak of approximately 29.8 at an AL value of 7.5. A third line, labeled “Consistency-Bi + beam,” is a dashed orange line with triangular markers, starting at approximately 27.0 and reaching a peak of approximately 30.6 at an AL value of 12.5.
